"""Verify real Linux forwarding/NAT and cleanup without trusting completion flags."""
import argparse
import ast
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

PACK = "NS6-Router-NAT-Topology-Lab"
FILES = ("README.md", "create_nat_lab.sh", "lab_runtime.py", "lab-rules.sh", "network-notes.md")


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def run(args, records, ready=None):
    started = now()
    process = subprocess.Popen(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                               start_new_session=True)
    cleanup = "exited and reaped"
    try:
        if ready:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
            while not ready.is_file() and time.monotonic() < deadline and process.poll() is None:
                time.sleep(0.05)
            assert ready.is_file(), "interruption case never reached a live owned HTTP worker"
            process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=75)
    except BaseException:
        cleanup = "terminated and reaped owned process group"
        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            process.communicate(timeout=12)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            process.communicate(timeout=3)
        raise
    finally:
        records.append({"task": "NS6-native-acceptance", "parentPid": os.getpid(),
                        "cwd": str(Path.cwd()), "command": args, "pid": process.pid,
                        "startTime": started, "endTime": now(), "exitCode": process.returncode,
                        "timeoutSeconds": 75, "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup})
    return process.returncode, stdout.decode(), stderr.decode()


def host_state(records):
    values = {}
    for name, args in (("links", ["ip", "-j", "link", "show"]),
                       ("routes", ["ip", "-j", "route", "show", "table", "all"]),
                       ("named", ["ip", "netns", "list"]),
                       ("forwarding", ["sysctl", "-n", "net.ipv4.ip_forward"]),
                       ("firewall", ["iptables-save"])):
        code, stdout, stderr = run(args, records)
        assert code == 0, stderr
        values[name] = "\n".join(re.sub(r"^(:\S+ \S+) \[\d+:\d+\]$", r"\1", line)
                                for line in stdout.splitlines() if not line.startswith("#"))
    values["networkNamespace"] = os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")
    values["mountNamespace"] = os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/mnt")
    return values


def check_cleanup(data):
    differences = {key: {"before": value, "after": data["hostAfter"][key]}
                   for key, value in data["hostBefore"].items()
                   if key != "firewallRaw" and value != data["hostAfter"][key]}
    assert not differences and data["hostUnchanged"] is True, differences
    lab = data["lab"]
    assert lab["networkNamespace"] != data["hostBefore"]["networkNamespace"]
    assert lab["mountNamespace"] != data["hostBefore"]["mountNamespace"]
    assert lab["cleanup"]["workerReaped"] is True
    assert lab["cleanup"]["namespacesRemoved"] is True
    assert lab["cleanup"]["remainingNamespaces"] == ""
    assert [row["ifname"] for row in lab["cleanup"]["remainingLinks"]] == ["lo"]
    assert lab["worker"]["reaped"] and lab["worker"]["exitCode"] is not None
    try:
        os.kill(lab["worker"]["pid"], 0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("owned HTTP worker PID still exists after return")
    for row in [*data["commands"], *lab["commands"]]:
        assert row["pid"] > 0 and row["parentPid"] > 0
        assert row["startTime"] <= row["endTime"] and row["exitCode"] is not None
    names = lab["names"]
    for role, interface, address, gateway in (("client", "c0", "10.10.0.2", "10.10.0.1"),
                                               ("server", "s0", "10.20.0.2", "10.20.0.1")):
        topology = lab["topology"][names[role]]
        assert any(row.get("dst") == "default" and row.get("gateway") == gateway
                   for row in topology["routes"])
        link = next(row for row in topology["addresses"] if row["ifname"] == interface)
        assert any(row.get("local") == address and row["prefixlen"] == 24 for row in link["addr_info"])
    for topology in lab["topology"].values():
        assert all(len(row["ifname"].encode()) <= 15 for row in topology["addresses"])


def check_flows(data, completed, policy_complete=False, interrupted=False):
    rows = data["lab"]["observations"]
    exposure = data["lab"]["exposurePolicyRequested"]
    stages = ["forwarding-off", "routed", "snat", "dnat", "mapping-removed", "direct-after-removal"]
    if exposure:
        stages += ["policy-baseline-direct", "policy-baseline-mapped"]
        if not interrupted:
            stages += ["policy-mapped-allowed", "policy-direct-blocked", "policy-direct-restored"]
    assert [row["stage"] for row in rows] == stages
    expected_peers = [None, "10.10.0.2", "10.20.0.1", "10.20.0.1", None, "10.20.0.1"]
    if exposure:
        expected_peers += ["10.20.0.1", "10.20.0.1"]
        if not interrupted:
            expected_peers += ["10.20.0.1", None if policy_complete else "10.20.0.1", "10.20.0.1"]
    if not completed:
        expected_peers = [None] * len(stages)
    for row, peer in zip(rows, expected_peers):
        response = row["response"]
        assert row["forwarding"] == ("1" if completed and row["stage"] != "forwarding-off" else "0")
        if peer is None:
            assert response["exitCode"] != 0 and response["body"] is None
        else:
            assert response["exitCode"] == 0
            assert response["body"] == {"token": data["token"], "peer": peer,
                                         "server": "10.20.0.2", "port": 8080, "path": "/lab"}
    if completed:
        assert "-j SNAT --to-source 10.20.0.1" in rows[2]["natRules"]
        assert "-j DNAT --to-destination 10.20.0.2:8080" in rows[3]["natRules"]
        assert "--dport 18080" in rows[3]["natRules"]
        assert "-j DNAT" not in rows[4]["natRules"]
        assert "-j SNAT" in rows[4]["natRules"]
    else:
        assert all("-j SNAT" not in row["natRules"] and "-j DNAT" not in row["natRules"] for row in rows)
    assert data["lab"]["baseComplete"] is completed
    if exposure:
        if policy_complete:
            assert re.search(r"^:FORWARD DROP \[\d+:\d+\]$", data["lab"]["policyBeforeInterruption"], re.MULTILINE)
            for fragment in ("--ctstate NEW", "--ctorigdst 10.10.0.1", "--ctorigdstport 18080", "--ctdir ORIGINAL"):
                assert fragment in data["lab"]["policyBeforeInterruption"]
        if not interrupted:
            current = rows[9]["filterRules"]
            policy = re.search(r"^:FORWARD (\S+) \[(\d+):\d+\]$", current, re.MULTILINE)
            assert policy
            accepts = [(int(count), rule) for count, rule in re.findall(r"^\[(\d+):\d+\] (-A FORWARD .*)$", current, re.MULTILINE)
                       if "-j ACCEPT" in rule]
            new_count = sum(count for count, rule in accepts if "--ctstate NEW" in rule
                            and "--ctorigdstport 18080" in rule)
            reply_count = sum(count for count, rule in accepts if "ESTABLISHED" in rule)
            assert data["lab"]["policyCounters"] == {
                "policy": policy[1], "dropped": int(policy[2]) if policy[1] == "DROP" else 0,
                "newMappedAccepted": new_count, "establishedAccepted": reply_count,
            }
            if policy_complete:
                assert policy[1] == "DROP" and int(policy[2]) > 0 and new_count > 0 and reply_count > 0
            else:
                assert policy[1] == "ACCEPT" and new_count == reply_count == 0
            assert re.search(r"^:FORWARD ACCEPT \[\d+:\d+\]$", rows[10]["filterRules"], re.MULTILINE)
            assert "-A FORWARD" not in rows[10]["filterRules"]
            if completed:
                assert all("-j SNAT" in row["natRules"] and "-j DNAT" in row["natRules"] for row in rows[6:])
    expected_completion = completed and (not exposure or policy_complete) and not interrupted
    assert data["lab"]["complete"] is expected_completion


def verify(root, proof, source_only):
    records = []
    result = {"mode": "source-only" if source_only else "isolated-linux-kernel",
              "nativeAccepted": False, "hashes": {}, "processes": records, "runs": []}
    try:
        pack = root / PACK
        for role in ("starter", "solution"):
            for name in FILES:
                path = pack / role / name
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                result["hashes"][str(path.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
                assert b"\r" not in raw, path
                if name.endswith(".py"):
                    ast.parse(raw, filename=str(path), feature_version=(3, 10))
                if name.endswith(".sh"):
                    assert run(["bash", "-n", str(path)], records)[0] == 0
                if name in ("README.md", "lab_runtime.py", "create_nat_lab.sh", "network-notes.md"):
                    assert raw == (pack / "starter" / name).read_bytes()
        guide = pack / "README.md"
        assert guide.read_bytes() == (pack / "starter/README.md").read_bytes()
        result["hashes"][str(guide.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(guide.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ns6_runtime", pack / "starter/lab_runtime.py")
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        raw = "# Generated at one time\n*filter\n:OUTPUT ACCEPT [12:430]\n-A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 8080 -j ACCEPT\nCOMMIT\n"
        canonical = module.firewall_configuration(raw)
        assert canonical == module.firewall_configuration(raw.replace("[12:430]", "[15:900]"))
        assert canonical != module.firewall_configuration(raw.replace("OUTPUT ACCEPT", "OUTPUT DROP"))
        assert canonical != module.firewall_configuration(raw.replace("8080", "18080"))
        assert canonical != module.firewall_configuration(raw.replace(":OUTPUT", ":INPUT"))
        result["firewallComparisonRegressionCases"] = 4
        if source_only:
            return result
        assert sys.platform == "linux" and os.geteuid() == 0
        host_before = host_state(records)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ns6-native-check-") as temp:
            for profile, source_role, completed, policy, exposure, mode in (
                    ("untouched-starter", "starter", False, False, False, "normal"),
                    ("completed-starter", "starter", True, False, False, "normal"),
                    ("reference", "solution", True, False, False, "normal"),
                    ("intentional-failure", "solution", True, False, False, "failure"),
                    ("cancel-live-worker", "solution", True, False, False, "cancellation"),
                    ("policy-untouched-starter", "starter", False, False, True, "normal"),
                    ("policy-completed-starter", "starter", True, True, True, "normal"),
                    ("policy-reference", "solution", True, True, True, "normal"),
                    ("policy-incomplete-starter", "starter", True, False, True, "normal"),
                    ("policy-intentional-failure", "solution", True, True, True, "failure"),
                    ("policy-cancel-live-worker", "solution", True, True, True, "cancellation")):
                work = Path(temp) / profile
                shutil.copytree(pack / source_role, work)
                if profile in ("completed-starter", "policy-completed-starter"):
                    # Only exercise cases differ; keep the starter apparatus.
                    shutil.copyfile(pack / "solution/lab-rules.sh", work / "lab-rules.sh")
                elif profile == "policy-incomplete-starter":
                    starter = (work / "lab-rules.sh").read_text()
                    reference = (pack / "solution/lab-rules.sh").read_text()
                    for stage in ("forwarding", "snat", "dnat"):
                        pattern = re.compile(r"^  " + stage + r"\)\n.*?^    ;;", re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
                        replacement = pattern.search(reference).group()
                        starter = pattern.sub(lambda _match, value=replacement: value, starter)
                    (work / "lab-rules.sh").write_text(starter)
                output, ready = work / "observations.json", work / "ready.txt"
                args = ["bash", str(work / "create_nat_lab.sh"), "--output", str(output),
                        "--test-mode", mode, "--ready-file", str(ready)]
                if exposure:
                    args.append("--exposure-policy")
                code, stdout, stderr = run(args, records, ready if mode == "cancellation" else None)
                data = json.loads(output.read_text())
                result["runs"].append({"profile": profile, "exitCode": code,
                                        "stdout": stdout, "stderr": stderr, "evidence": data})
                check_cleanup(data)
                assert host_state(records) == host_before
                if mode == "normal":
                    assert code == 0, (stdout, stderr)
                    check_flows(data, completed, policy)
                else:
                    assert code != 0 and "error" in data["lab"]
                    assert not data["lab"]["complete"]
                    if exposure:
                        check_flows(data, completed, policy, interrupted=True)
        # Direct internal entry must refuse the host before any mounting or changes.
        code, _, stderr = run([sys.executable, str(pack / "solution/lab_runtime.py"),
                               "--inside", os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")], records)
        assert code == 2 and "refusing to alter the original" in stderr
        assert host_state(records) == host_before
        result["hostUnchanged"] = True
        result["nativeAccepted"] = True
        return result
    finally:
        proof.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        proof.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path, required=True)
    options = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in verify(
        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], options.proof, options.source_only).items()
        if key in ("mode", "nativeAccepted", "hostUnchanged")}))

"""Check actual owned HTTP packet bytes, selection and cleanup on Linux."""
import argparse
import ast
import base64
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

PACK = "NS5-Tcpdump-HTTP-Capture"
FILES = ("capture_http.sh", "capture-options.sh", "capture_runtime.py", "network-notes.md", "README.md")


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def run(argv, ledger, ready=None):
    started = now()
    process = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                               start_new_session=True)
    cleanup = "exited and reaped"
    try:
        if ready:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
            while not ready.exists() and process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
                time.sleep(0.03)
            assert ready.exists(), "capture never reached actual readiness"
            process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=35)
    except BaseException:
        cleanup = "terminated and reaped owned process group"
        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            process.communicate(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            process.communicate(timeout=3)
        raise
    finally:
        ledger.append({"task": "NS5-native-capture-acceptance", "cwd": str(Path.cwd()),
                       "command": argv, "parentPid": os.getpid(), "pid": process.pid,
                       "startTime": started, "endTime": now(), "exitCode": process.returncode,
                       "timeoutSeconds": 35, "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup})
    return process.returncode, stdout.decode(), stderr.decode()


def wire_packets(raw):
    assert len(raw) >= 24
    byte_order = "<" if raw[:4] in (bytes.fromhex("d4c3b2a1"), bytes.fromhex("4d3cb2a1")) else ">"
    assert raw[:4] in [bytes.fromhex(x) for x in ("d4c3b2a1", "a1b2c3d4", "4d3cb2a1", "a1b23c4d")]
    assert struct.unpack(byte_order + "I", raw[20:24])[0] == 1
    frames = []
    cursor = 24
    while cursor < len(raw):
        stamp, fraction, length, original = struct.unpack_from(byte_order + "4I", raw, cursor)
        cursor += 16
        frame = raw[cursor:cursor + length]
        assert len(frame) == length <= original <= 65536
        cursor += length
        assert frame[12:14] == bytes.fromhex("0800")
        ip = frame[14:]
        assert ip[0] >> 4 == 4 and ip[9] == 6
        ip_length = struct.unpack_from("!H", ip, 2)[0]
        assert len(ip) >= ip_length
        segment = ip[4 * (ip[0] & 15):ip_length]
        sport, dport, seq, ack = struct.unpack_from("!HHII", segment)
        header_length = (segment[12] >> 4) * 4
        assert 20 <= header_length <= len(segment)
        frames.append({"seconds": stamp, "fraction": fraction,
                       "source": socket.inet_ntoa(ip[12:16]), "destination": socket.inet_ntoa(ip[16:20]),
                       "sourcePort": sport, "destinationPort": dport, "sequence": seq,
                       "acknowledgement": ack, "flags": segment[13],
                       "payloadBase64": base64.b64encode(segment[header_length:]).decode()})
    assert cursor == len(raw)
    return frames


def check_run(data, complete, mode, reverse):
    assert data["hostUnchanged"] and data["hostBefore"] == data["hostAfter"]
    lab = data["lab"]
    assert lab["networkNamespace"] != data["hostBefore"]["networkNamespace"]
    assert lab["workerReady"]["networkNamespace"] == lab["networkNamespace"]
    assert lab["workerReady"]["token"] == data["token"] and lab["workerReady"]["ports"] == [8080, 8081]
    assert lab["cleanup"]["workerReaped"] and lab["cleanup"]["captureReaped"]
    assert [row["ifname"] for row in lab["cleanup"]["remainingLinks"]] == ["lo"]
    for child in (lab["worker"], lab["capture"]):
        assert child["reaped"] and child["pid"] > 0 and child["exitCode"] is not None
        try:
            os.kill(child["pid"], 0)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("an owned capture or HTTP worker remains alive")
    for row in data["commands"] + lab["commands"]:
        assert row["pid"] > 0 and row["parentPid"] > 0 and row["exitCode"] is not None
        assert row["endTime"] >= row["startTime"] and row["timeoutSeconds"] in (5, 20)
    raw = base64.b64decode(lab["pcapBase64"], validate=True)
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == lab["pcapSha256"]
    frames = wire_packets(raw)
    assert frames == lab["packets"]
    assert all(row["source"] == row["destination"] == "127.0.0.1" for row in frames)
    captured = re.search(r"(\d+) packets captured", lab["capture"]["stderr"])
    assert captured and int(captured[1]) == len(frames)
    capture = next(row for row in lab["commands"] if row["pid"] == lab["capture"]["pid"])
    argv = capture["command"]
    assert argv[:2] == ["tcpdump", "--immediate-mode"] and argv[argv.index("-i") + 1] == "lo"
    assert "-p" in argv
    assert argv[-1] == "tcp and host 127.0.0.1" + (" and port 8080" if complete else "")
    assert "-nn" in argv and (("-c" in argv) is complete)
    if complete:
        assert argv[argv.index("-c") + 1] == "64"
    if mode == "hold":
        assert not lab["requests"] and not data["complete"] and "signal" in lab["error"]
        return len(frames), 0
    assert len(lab["requests"]) == 3
    assert [row["peer"][1] for row in lab["requests"]] == ([8080, 8081, 8081] if reverse else [8081, 8080, 8081])
    target = next(row for row in lab["requests"] if row["peer"][1] == 8080)
    source_port = target["local"][1]
    assert source_port > 1023 and target["local"][0] == target["peer"][0] == "127.0.0.1"
    for row in lab["requests"]:
        assert row["networkNamespace"] == lab["networkNamespace"]
        assert row["body"] == {"token": data["token"], "pid": lab["worker"]["pid"],
                               "port": row["peer"][1], "path": "/capture/" + data["token"]}
        assert base64.b64decode(row["requestBase64"], validate=True).startswith(b"GET /capture/" + data["token"].encode() + b" HTTP/1.1\r\n")
        assert base64.b64decode(row["responseBase64"], validate=True).startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 200 ")
    selected = [row for row in frames if {row["sourcePort"], row["destinationPort"]} == {source_port, 8080}]
    assert selected and any(row["sourcePort"] == source_port and row["flags"] & 0x12 == 2 for row in selected)
    assert any(row["sourcePort"] == 8080 and row["flags"] & 0x12 == 0x12 for row in selected)
    requests = b"".join(base64.b64decode(row["payloadBase64"]) for row in selected if row["destinationPort"] == 8080)
    replies = b"".join(base64.b64decode(row["payloadBase64"]) for row in selected if row["sourcePort"] == 8080)
    assert base64.b64decode(target["requestBase64"]) in requests
    assert b"HTTP/1.1 200 " in replies and data["token"].encode() in replies
    has_noise = any(8081 in (row["sourcePort"], row["destinationPort"]) for row in frames)
    assert has_noise is not complete
    if complete:
        assert "127.0.0.1.8080" in lab["decoded"]["stdout"] and "127.0.0.1.8081" not in lab["decoded"]["stdout"]
    assert data["complete"] is (complete and mode == "normal")
    if mode == "failure":
        assert "controlled failure" in lab["error"]
    else:
        assert "error" not in data and "error" not in lab
    return len(frames), 3


def verify(root, proof, source_only):
    result = {"nativeAccepted": False, "mode": "source-only" if source_only else "owned-linux-packet-capture",
              "sourceHashes": {}, "processes": [], "runs": [], "refusals": []}
    ledger = result["processes"]
    pack = root / PACK
    try:
        for role in ("starter", "solution"):
            for name in FILES:
                path = pack / role / name
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                result["sourceHashes"][str(path.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
                assert b"\r" not in raw
                if name.endswith(".py"):
                    ast.parse(raw, filename=str(path), feature_version=(3, 10))
                if name.endswith(".sh"):
                    assert run(["bash", "-n", str(path)], ledger)[0] == 0
                if name != "capture-options.sh":
                    assert raw == (pack / "starter" / name).read_bytes()
        assert (pack / "README.md").read_bytes() == (pack / "starter/README.md").read_bytes()
        result["sourceHashes"][PACK + "/README.md"] = hashlib.sha256((pack / "README.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if source_only:
            return result
        assert sys.platform == "linux" and os.geteuid() == 0
        frames = requests = 0
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ns5-native-check-") as temp:
            for profile, source_role, complete in (("untouched-starter", "starter", False),
                                                   ("completed-starter", "starter", True),
                                                   ("reference", "solution", True)):
                for reverse in (False, True):
                    name = profile + ("-reversed" if reverse else "")
                    work = Path(temp) / (name + " quoted workspace")
                    shutil.copytree(pack / source_role, work)
                    if profile == "completed-starter":
                        shutil.copyfile(pack / "solution/capture-options.sh", work / "capture-options.sh")
                    output = work / "observations.json"
                    argv = ["bash", str(work / "capture_http.sh"), "--output", str(output)] + (["--reverse"] if reverse else [])
                    status, stdout, stderr = run(argv, ledger)
                    assert status == 0, (stdout, stderr, output.read_text() if output.exists() else "no report")
                    data = json.loads(output.read_text())
                    result["runs"].append({"profile": name, "status": status, "stdout": stdout, "stderr": stderr, "evidence": data})
                    observed, sent = check_run(data, complete, "normal", reverse)
                    frames += observed
                    requests += sent
            for mode in ("failure", "hold"):
                work = Path(temp) / (mode + " quoted workspace")
                shutil.copytree(pack / "solution", work)
                output, ready = work / "observations.json", work / "ready"
                argv = ["bash", str(work / "capture_http.sh"), "--output", str(output), "--test-mode", mode]
                if mode == "hold":
                    argv += ["--ready-file", str(ready)]
                status, stdout, stderr = run(argv, ledger, ready if mode == "hold" else None)
                assert status != 0 and output.exists(), (stdout, stderr)
                data = json.loads(output.read_text())
                result["runs"].append({"profile": mode, "status": status, "stdout": stdout, "stderr": stderr, "evidence": data})
                observed, sent = check_run(data, True, mode, False)
                frames += observed
                requests += sent
            sentinel = Path(temp) / "outside"
            sentinel.write_text("outside content remains unchanged\n")
            link = Path(temp) / "output-symlink"
            link.symlink_to(sentinel)
            for name, argv in (
                    ("existing output", ["bash", str(pack / "solution/capture_http.sh"), "--output", str(sentinel)]),
                    ("symlink output", ["bash", str(pack / "solution/capture_http.sh"), "--output", str(link)]),
                    ("missing output parent", ["bash", str(pack / "solution/capture_http.sh"), "--output", str(Path(temp) / "missing/report.json")]),
                    ("direct internal host capture", [sys.executable, str(pack / "solution/capture_runtime.py"), "--inside", "--origin", os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")])):
                status, stdout, stderr = run(argv, ledger)
                assert status == 2 and not stdout and stderr
                assert sentinel.read_text() == "outside content remains unchanged\n" and link.is_symlink()
                result["refusals"].append({"case": name, "status": status, "stdout": stdout, "stderr": stderr})
        assert requests == 21 and len(result["runs"]) == 8 and len(result["refusals"]) == 4
        for name, digest in result["sourceHashes"].items():
            assert hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
        result.update(nativeAccepted=True, actualCapturedPackets=frames, actualHttpRequests=requests,
                      captureProfiles=8, actualCaptureProcesses=8, actualHttpWorkers=8,
                      reversedTrafficProfiles=3, controlledFailureAndCancellationCleaned=True,
                      hostNetworkConfigurationPreserved=True, sourceUnchanged=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        result["error"] = str(error)
        raise
    finally:
        proof.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        proof.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
    parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    accepted = verify(args.root, args.proof, args.source_only)
    print(json.dumps({"nativeAccepted": accepted["nativeAccepted"], "sourceFiles": len(accepted["sourceHashes"]),
                      "captureProfiles": accepted.get("captureProfiles", 0), "actualHttpRequests": accepted.get("actualHttpRequests", 0)}))

"""Check actual routed peers, mappings and exposure before accepting a task."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile

from kernel_optional_source import CASES, ROOT, digest, source_checks
from verify_topology import check_cleanup, check_flows, now, run

BASE_STAGES = ["forwarding-off", "routed", "snat", "dnat", "mapping-removed", "direct-after-removal"]
POLICY_STAGES = ["policy-baseline-direct", "policy-baseline-mapped", "policy-mapped-allowed",
                 "policy-direct-blocked", "policy-direct-restored"]
BASE_PEERS = [None, "10.10.0.2", "10.20.0.1", "10.20.0.1", None, "10.20.0.1"]
STARTER_PEERS = {
    "snat-source": [None, "10.10.0.2", "10.10.0.2", "10.10.0.2", None, "10.10.0.2"],
    "dnat-port": [None, "10.10.0.2", "10.20.0.1", None, None, "10.20.0.1"],
    "exposure-bypass": BASE_PEERS + ["10.20.0.1"] * 5,
    "exposure-port": BASE_PEERS + ["10.20.0.1", "10.20.0.1", None, None, "10.20.0.1"],
}


def check_observations(data, kind, corrected, mode):
    check_cleanup(data)
    lab = data["lab"]
    exposure = kind.startswith("exposure-")
    assert lab["exposurePolicyRequested"] is exposure
    assert lab["worker"]["reaped"]
    rows = lab["observations"]
    if mode != "normal":
        assert lab.get("error") and lab["complete"] is False
        if mode == "cancellation":
            assert lab["error"] == data.get("error") == "lab interrupted; cleaning up owned resources"
            check_flows(data, True, policy_complete=True, interrupted=True)
            assert [r["stage"] for r in rows] == BASE_STAGES + POLICY_STAGES[:2]
            assert re.search(r"^:FORWARD DROP \[\d+:\d+\]$", lab["policyBeforeInterruption"], re.M)
        else:
            assert lab["error"] == "intentional failure after owned topology setup"
        return
    assert "error" not in lab and "error" not in data
    stages = BASE_STAGES + (POLICY_STAGES if exposure else [])
    peers = (BASE_PEERS + (["10.20.0.1", "10.20.0.1", "10.20.0.1", None, "10.20.0.1"]
             if exposure else [])) if corrected else STARTER_PEERS[kind]
    assert [row["stage"] for row in rows] == stages
    for row, peer in zip(rows, peers):
        response = row["response"]
        assert row["forwarding"] == ("0" if row["stage"] == "forwarding-off" else "1")
        if peer is None:
            assert response["exitCode"] != 0 and response["body"] is None
        else:
            assert response["exitCode"] == 0
            expected = {"token": data["token"], "peer": peer, "server": "10.20.0.2", "port": 8080, "path": "/lab"}
            assert response["body"] == json.loads(response["stdout"]) == expected
    assert lab["baseComplete"] is (corrected or exposure)
    assert lab["complete"] is corrected
    translated, mapped = rows[2]["natRules"], rows[3]["natRules"]
    if kind == "snat-source":
        source = "10.10.0.0/24" if corrected else "10.99.0.0/24"
        assert "-s " + source in translated
    assert "-j SNAT --to-source 10.20.0.1" in translated
    port = 8081 if kind == "dnat-port" and not corrected else 8080
    assert "-j DNAT --to-destination 10.20.0.2:" + str(port) in mapped
    assert "-j DNAT" not in rows[4]["natRules"] and "-j SNAT" in rows[4]["natRules"]
    if exposure:
        rules = rows[9]["filterRules"]
        policy = re.search(r"^:FORWARD DROP \[(\d+):\d+\]$", rules, re.M)
        assert policy and "--ctstate NEW" in rules and "--ctdir ORIGINAL" in rules
        assert "--ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED" in rules or "--ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED" in rules
        if kind == "exposure-bypass" and not corrected:
            assert "--ctorigdstport" not in rules
        else:
            assert "--ctorigdst 10.10.0.1" in rules and "--ctorigdstport 18080" in rules
        new_rules = [line for line in rules.splitlines() if "-A FORWARD" in line and "--ctstate NEW" in line]
        assert len(new_rules) == 1
        assert "--dport " + ("18080" if kind == "exposure-port" and not corrected else "8080") in new_rules[0]
        if corrected:
            assert int(policy[1]) > 0 and lab["policyCounters"]["newMappedAccepted"] > 0
            assert lab["policyCounters"]["establishedAccepted"] > 0
        assert re.search(r"^:FORWARD ACCEPT \[\d+:\d+\]$", rows[-1]["filterRules"], re.M)
        assert "-A FORWARD" not in rows[-1]["filterRules"]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--exported-source", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.proof = args.proof.resolve()
    raw = args.proof.parent / "routing-optional-raw"
    raw.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    proof = {"at": now(), "nativeAccepted": False, "processes": [], "runs": []}
    try:
        proof["sourceFiles"] = source_checks("routing", run, proof["processes"], args.exported_source)
        if args.source_only:
            return
        assert sys.platform == "linux" and os.geteuid() == 0
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="network-routing-optional-") as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            for definition in CASES["routing"]:
                pack, kind = definition["pack"], definition["kind"]
                for variant in ["starter", "solution", "corrected"]:
                    work = root / (kind + "-" + variant + " quoted workspace")
                    shutil.copytree(ROOT / pack / ("starter" if variant == "corrected" else variant), work)
                    if variant == "corrected":
                        original = (work / "lab-rules.sh").read_text()
                        reference = (ROOT / pack / "solution/lab-rules.sh").read_text()
                        pattern = re.compile(r"^  " + definition["stage"] + r"\)\n.*?^    ;;", re.M | re.S)
                        old_case, new_case = pattern.search(original), pattern.search(reference)
                        assert old_case and new_case
                        fixed = original[:old_case.start()] + new_case.group() + original[old_case.end():]
                        assert len(original.splitlines()) == len(fixed.splitlines())
                        assert sum(a != b for a, b in zip(original.splitlines(), fixed.splitlines())) == 1
                        (work / "lab-rules.sh").write_text(fixed)
                    assert digest(work / "lab_runtime.py") == CASES["qualifiedApparatus"]["routing"]["lab_runtime.py"]
                    label = kind + "-" + variant
                    observe(work, label, kind, variant != "starter", "normal", definition["exposure"], raw, proof)
            for kind, mode in [("snat-source", "failure"), ("exposure-port", "cancellation")]:
                definition = next(r for r in CASES["routing"] if r["kind"] == kind)
                work = ROOT / definition["pack"] / "solution"
                observe(work, kind + "-" + mode, kind, True, mode, definition["exposure"], raw, proof)
        assert source_checks("routing", run, proof["processes"], args.exported_source) == proof["sourceFiles"]
        proof.update(nativeAccepted=True, actualProfiles=len(proof["runs"]), oneFileCorrections=4,
                     observedHTTPRequests=sum(len(r["evidence"]["lab"]["observations"]) for r in proof["runs"]),
                     actualHostAndNamespaceCleanupVerified=True, unchangedQualifiedApparatus=True)
    finally:
        proof["endedAt"] = now()
        args.proof.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.proof.write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in proof.items() if k not in ["sourceFiles", "processes", "runs"]}))


def observe(work, label, kind, corrected, mode, exposure, raw, proof):
    report, ready = raw / (label + ".json"), raw / (label + "-ready.txt")
    argv = ["bash", str(work / "create_nat_lab.sh"), "--output", str(report),
            "--test-mode", mode, "--ready-file", str(ready)]
    if exposure:
        argv.append("--exposure-policy")
    code, stdout, stderr = run(argv, proof["processes"], ready if mode == "cancellation" else None)
    (raw / (label + ".stdout")).write_text(stdout)
    (raw / (label + ".stderr")).write_text(stderr)
    assert code == (0 if mode == "normal" else 1), (label, code, stderr)
    data = json.loads(report.read_text())
    proof["runs"].append({"profile": label, "kind": kind, "corrected": corrected, "mode": mode,
                          "exitCode": code, "rawReport": str(report), "rawSHA256": digest(report), "evidence": data})
    check_observations(data, kind, corrected, mode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify capture choices against retained packet bytes and actual HTTP traffic."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile

from kernel_optional_source import CASES, ROOT, digest, source_checks
from verify_capture import now, run, wire_packets


def stream_bytes(frames, source_port):
    selected = [row for row in frames if row["sourcePort"] == source_port]
    payloads = [row for row in selected if base64.b64decode(row["payloadBase64"])]
    if not payloads:
        return b""
    syn = next((row for row in selected if row["flags"] & 2), None)
    origin = (syn["sequence"] + 1) & 0xffffffff if syn else payloads[0]["sequence"]
    values = {}
    for row in payloads:
        offset = (row["sequence"] - origin) & 0xffffffff
        data = base64.b64decode(row["payloadBase64"], validate=True)
        assert offset + len(data) <= 65536
        for index, byte in enumerate(data, offset):
            assert index not in values or values[index] == byte
            values[index] = byte
    assert set(values) == set(range(max(values) + 1)), "gap in the retained owned TCP stream"
    return bytes(values[index] for index in range(len(values)))


def check_observations(data, settings, complete, mode, reverse):
    assert data["hostUnchanged"] and data["hostBefore"] == data["hostAfter"]
    lab = data["lab"]
    assert lab["networkNamespace"] != data["hostBefore"]["networkNamespace"]
    assert lab["workerReady"]["networkNamespace"] == lab["networkNamespace"]
    assert lab["workerReady"]["ports"] == [8080, 8081]
    assert lab["workerReady"]["pid"] == lab["worker"]["pid"]
    assert lab["workerReady"]["token"] == data["token"]
    assert lab["settings"] == settings
    for name in ["worker", "capture"]:
        assert lab["cleanup"][name + "Reaped"] and lab[name]["reaped"]
        assert lab[name]["exitCode"] is not None
        try:
            os.kill(lab[name]["pid"], 0)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("owned child remains alive")
    assert [row["ifname"] for row in lab["cleanup"]["remainingLinks"]] == ["lo"]
    for row in data["commands"] + lab["commands"]:
        assert row["pid"] > 0 and row["parentPid"] > 0 and row["exitCode"] is not None
        assert row["startTime"] <= row["endTime"]
    raw = base64.b64decode(lab["pcapBase64"], validate=True)
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == lab["pcapSha256"]
    frames = wire_packets(raw)
    assert frames == lab["packets"]
    assert all(row["source"] == row["destination"] == "127.0.0.1" for row in frames)
    captured = re.search(r"(\d+) packets captured", lab["capture"]["stderr"])
    assert captured and int(captured[1]) == len(frames)
    invocation = next(row for row in lab["commands"] if row["pid"] == lab["capture"]["pid"])["command"]
    assert invocation[:2] == ["tcpdump", "--immediate-mode"] and invocation[invocation.index("-i") + 1] == "lo"
    assert "-p" in invocation and "-nn" in invocation and "-U" in invocation
    assert invocation[-1] == "tcp and host 127.0.0.1" + (" and port 8080" if settings["filterPort"] else "")
    assert ("-c" in invocation) is bool(settings["packetLimit"])
    if settings["packetLimit"]:
        assert invocation[invocation.index("-c") + 1] == str(settings["packetLimit"])
        assert len(frames) <= settings["packetLimit"]
    assert data["complete"] is complete and lab["complete"] is complete
    if mode == "hold":
        assert not lab["requests"] and lab.get("error") and "signal" in lab["error"]
        return frames, 0
    requests = lab["requests"]
    assert len(requests) == 3
    assert [row["peer"][1] for row in requests] == ([8080, 8081, 8081] if reverse else [8081, 8080, 8081])
    for row in requests:
        assert row["networkNamespace"] == lab["networkNamespace"]
        assert row["body"] == {"token": data["token"], "pid": lab["worker"]["pid"],
                               "port": row["peer"][1], "path": "/capture/" + data["token"]}
        assert base64.b64decode(row["requestBase64"], validate=True).startswith(
            b"GET /capture/" + data["token"].encode() + b" HTTP/1.1\r\n")
        assert base64.b64decode(row["responseBase64"], validate=True).startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 200 ")
    target_request = next(row for row in requests if row["peer"][1] == 8080)
    source_port = target_request["local"][1]
    target = [row for row in frames if 8080 in (row["sourcePort"], row["destinationPort"])]
    noise = [row for row in frames if 8081 in (row["sourcePort"], row["destinationPort"])]
    chosen = [row for row in target if {row["sourcePort"], row["destinationPort"]} == {source_port, 8080}]
    assert chosen
    request_bytes, response_bytes = stream_bytes(chosen, source_port), stream_bytes(chosen, 8080)
    request_visible = b"GET /capture/" + data["token"].encode() in request_bytes
    response_visible = b"HTTP/1.1 200 " in response_bytes
    token_visible = data["token"].encode() in response_bytes
    analysis = {"targetPackets": len(target), "noisePackets": len(noise),
                "requestVisible": request_visible, "responseVisible": response_visible,
                "responseTokenVisible": token_visible,
                "synObserved": any(row["flags"] & 0x12 == 2 for row in target),
                "synAckObserved": any(row["flags"] & 0x12 == 0x12 for row in target)}
    assert analysis == lab["analysis"]
    if settings["filterPort"]:
        assert not noise
    else:
        assert noise, "the broad filter must actually retain the owned second service"
    if settings["packetLimit"] == 2:
        assert len(frames) == 2 and not request_visible and not response_visible and not token_visible
    else:
        assert base64.b64decode(target_request["requestBase64"]) == request_bytes
        assert base64.b64decode(target_request["responseBase64"]) == response_bytes
        assert request_visible and response_visible and token_visible
    independently_complete = (mode == "normal" and settings["packetLimit"] > 0 and settings["filterPort"]
                              and not noise and request_visible and response_visible and token_visible
                              and analysis["synObserved"] and analysis["synAckObserved"])
    assert independently_complete is complete
    if mode == "failure":
        assert "controlled failure" in lab["error"]
    else:
        assert "error" not in data and "error" not in lab
    return frames, 3


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--proof", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--exported-source", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.proof = args.proof.resolve()
    raw = args.proof.parent / "capture-optional-raw"
    raw.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    proof = {"at": now(), "nativeAccepted": False, "sourceFiles": {}, "processes": [], "runs": []}
    try:
        proof["sourceFiles"] = source_checks("capture", run, proof["processes"], args.exported_source)
        if args.source_only:
            return
        assert sys.platform == "linux" and os.geteuid() == 0
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="network-capture-optional-") as temporary:
            scenarios = [(0, "starter", None, False, "normal"), (0, "solution", None, False, "normal"),
                         (0, "corrected", {"packetLimit": 64, "filterPort": True}, True, "normal"),
                         (0, "alternate-bound", {"packetLimit": 32, "filterPort": True}, False, "normal"),
                         (0, "zero-bound-control", {"packetLimit": 0, "filterPort": True}, False, "normal"),
                         (1, "starter", None, False, "normal"), (1, "solution", None, True, "normal"),
                         (1, "corrected", {"packetLimit": 64, "filterPort": True}, False, "normal"),
                         (1, "broad-reverse-control", {"packetLimit": 64, "filterPort": False}, True, "normal"),
                         (0, "failure", None, False, "failure"), (1, "hold", None, False, "hold")]
            for index, variant, changed, reverse, mode in scenarios:
                definition = CASES["capture"][index]
                role = variant if variant in ["starter", "solution"] else "solution" if mode != "normal" else "starter"
                label = definition["kind"] + "-" + variant
                work = Path(temporary) / (label + " quoted workspace")
                shutil.copytree(ROOT / definition["pack"] / role, work)
                if changed is not None:
                    path = work / "capture-options.sh"
                    text = path.read_text()
                    old = definition["referenceSettings"] if role == "solution" else definition["starterSettings"]
                    assert text.count(json.dumps(old, separators=(",", ":"))) == 1
                    path.write_text(text.replace(json.dumps(old, separators=(",", ":")),
                                                json.dumps(changed, separators=(",", ":")), 1))
                settings = changed or definition["starterSettings" if role == "starter" else "referenceSettings"]
                assert digest(work / "capture_runtime.py") == CASES["qualifiedApparatus"]["capture"]["capture_runtime.py"]
                report, ready = raw / (label + ".json"), raw / (label + "-ready.txt")
                argv = ["bash", str(work / "capture_http.sh"), "--output", str(report), "--test-mode", mode]
                if reverse:
                    argv.append("--reverse")
                if mode == "hold":
                    argv += ["--ready-file", str(ready)]
                code, stdout, stderr = run(argv, proof["processes"], ready if mode == "hold" else None)
                (raw / (label + ".stdout")).write_text(stdout)
                (raw / (label + ".stderr")).write_text(stderr)
                assert code == (0 if mode == "normal" else 2), (label, code, stderr)
                data = json.loads(report.read_text())
                complete = mode == "normal" and settings["filterPort"] and settings["packetLimit"] >= 32
                row = {"profile": label, "settings": settings, "mode": mode, "reverse": reverse,
                       "exitCode": code, "rawReport": str(report), "rawSHA256": digest(report), "evidence": data}
                proof["runs"].append(row)
                frames, requests = check_observations(data, settings, complete, mode, reverse)
                pcap = base64.b64decode(data["lab"]["pcapBase64"], validate=True)
                (raw / (label + ".pcap")).write_bytes(pcap)
                row.update(independentFrames=frames, actualRequests=requests)
        assert source_checks("capture", run, proof["processes"], args.exported_source) == proof["sourceFiles"]
        proof.update(nativeAccepted=True, actualProfiles=len(proof["runs"]), oneSettingCorrections=2,
                     independentPackets=sum(len(r["independentFrames"]) for r in proof["runs"]),
                     actualHTTPRequests=sum(r["actualRequests"] for r in proof["runs"]),
                     actualInsufficientCaptureVerified=True, actualNoiseAndOrderControlsVerified=True,
                     unchangedQualifiedApparatus=True)
    finally:
        proof["endedAt"] = now()
        args.proof.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.proof.write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in proof.items() if k not in ["sourceFiles", "processes", "runs"]}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
